data.gender_notes: Sharvitika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharvitika is a combination of two Sanskrit words: 'Sharva' which means 'God' and 'Vitika' which means 'Goddess of Prosperity'. It is a name of Goddess Lakshmi, the Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity. The name Sharvitika carries the meaning “Goddess of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvitika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharvitika represents the divine feminine energy and is believed to bring wealth, prosperity, and good fortune to the bearer of the name.
data.etymology: Sharvitika belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvitika total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
